ticks.note: Region `A` tests `!busy` before its own emission: a region does not see its own future, so `busy` is absent at that point, A emits it and starts working. Region `B`'s test waits for every emission of `busy` in this tick, sees it present and stays in `Idle`.
Nobody emits `busy` now, so it is absent. `B`'s immediate transition fires.
